input.context: Every .gepa/eval/*.jsonl case file has a `notes` field that is a JSON-stringified blob (bug_class, severity_expected, provenance, verdict_expected) embedded inside a JSON string value — a string-within-JSON encoding chosen early and now duplicated across dozens of hand-seeded cases. A new SLICE wants notes to be a real nested object so tooling can query provenance without a second JSON.parse. Plan the migration across agents/architect and agents/reviewer's case files without breaking rubricScorer, which currently reads notes as an opaque string and never parses it.
constraints: rubricScorer (gepa-core) treats notes as opaque — must not require a gepa-core release to keep working mid-migration
Case files are hand-authored and reviewed in PRs — migration script output must be a clean diff a human can review, not a wall of reformatted JSON
Existing trial history (none yet recorded per FEAT-210) means no backward-compat read path for old trial rows is required

expected_output.summary: One-shot codemod script (scripts/migrate-eval-notes.ts) rewrites `notes` from a JSON-stringified value to a nested object in place across both agents' eval directories; rubricScorer needs zero changes since it never parses notes; a follow-on gepa-core release can add optional typed notes support later without urgency
expected_output.non_goals_explicit: Does not touch trial JSONL under .claude/artifacts/crew/gepa/trials (none exist yet); does not add a Zod schema for notes in this pass — that is deferred until a consumer actually needs typed reads
failure_modes_named: Codemod double-encodes an already-migrated file if run twice — must be idempotent, checked via a shape guard before rewrite
Case files with malformed notes JSON (typo, missing field) fail the codemod loudly rather than silently writing null

dependencies_graphed.codemod_script: scripts/migrate-eval-notes.ts — reads *.jsonl, JSON.parse(notes) for detection, rewrites in place
dependencies_graphed.ci_gate: validate-slices.ts or a new validate-eval-cases.ts extended to reject any surviving stringified notes post-migration
dependencies_graphed.case_authors: future hand-seeded cases write notes as a nested object directly per an updated CONTRIBUTING note

interfaces_typed.EvalCaseNotes: { bug_class: string | null; severity_expected: string | null; provenance: string; verdict_expected?: string }

expected_output.test_strategy_present: Golden-file test: run codemod against a fixture directory with 3 known-shape cases, assert byte-exact expected output; idempotency test: run codemod twice, assert second run is a no-op diff
expected_output.tradeoffs_articulated: A big-bang single-commit migration across both agents was chosen over a per-agent staged rollout because there is no consumer depending on the old shape yet (rubricScorer is agnostic) — staging would add coordination overhead with no risk reduction benefit

notes: hand-seed 2026-07-02 FEAT-210 — held-out set expansion for detectEvalDrift minSampleSize; migration_plan scenario, distinct from existing 8 seeds.
